chapter.li: LEChapter8 Verse1 Now I Moroni will finish my father Mormon’s record. I only have a few things to write, things I was commanded to write by my father. VerseEnd Verse2 After the great and awful battle at Cumorah, any Nephites who escaped to the south were hunted by the Lamanites and all killed. VerseEnd Verse3 They killed my father also. As a result, I’m the only one who remains to write the sad tale of my people’s destruction. They’re gone, and I will follow my father’s commandment. I don’t know whether they’ll kill me. VerseEnd Verse4 Therefore I’ll write and conceal the records in the ground. It doesn’t matter what happens to me. VerseEnd Verse5 My father has made this record, and he has described its purpose. I would also write about it if I had room on the plates, but I don’t. I don’t have any ore, as I’m alone. My father was killed in battle, along with all my relatives. I don’t have any friends or anywhere to go. I don’t know how long the Lord will let me live. VerseEnd Verse6 Four hundred years have come and gone since the coming of our Lord and Savior. VerseEnd Verse7 The Lamanites have hunted down my people the Nephites from city to city and place to place until they’re all dead. Their fall was immense; indeed, the destruction of my people the Nephites is remarkable and astonishing. VerseEnd Verse8 It’s the Lord’s hand that’s done it. The Lamanites are now at war with each other — the whole land is one continual round of murder and killing, and no one knows when the war will end. VerseEnd

Verse9 Now I won’t describe them further, since there isn’t anyone living now except Lamanites and robbers. VerseEnd Verse10 There isn’t anyone who knows the true God, except for Jesus’ disciples who stayed in the land until the people’s wickedness was so great the Lord wouldn’t let them remain with the people. No one knows where they are. VerseEnd Verse11 But my father and I have seen them, and they’ve ministered to us. VerseEnd Verse12 Whoever receives this record and doesn’t condemn it because of its imperfections will learn of greater things than these. I’m Moroni. If it were possible, I would make all things known to 2PP you. VerseEnd

Verse13 Now I’ll finish writing about this people. I’m Mormon’s son, and my father was a descendant of Nephi. VerseEnd Verse14 I’m the same one who will hide away this record under the Lord’s care. The plates themselves aren’t valuable because of the commandment of the Lord, for He truly said no one will have them for the purpose of getting rich. But the record written on them is very valuable. And the Lord will bless whoever brings it to light. VerseEnd Verse15 No one can have power to bring it to light unless God gives it to him, because God ordains it can only be done with an eye toward His glory or to benefit the Lord’s ancient and long-dispersed covenant people. VerseEnd Verse16 Blessed is the one who brings this thing to light; it will be brought out of darkness to light, according to God’s word. Indeed, it will be brought out of the ground. It will shine out from darkness and come to the knowledge of the people. It will be done by God’s power. VerseEnd Verse17 If there are any errors, they’re human mistakes; but we don’t know of any error. Nevertheless, God knows all things. Therefore any who condemn, let them be careful not to put themselves in danger of hell fire. VerseEnd Verse18 Those who say: Show it to me or I’ll strike 2PP you down! Let them be careful not to demand what the Lord forbids. VerseEnd Verse19 Because those who judge rashly will in turn be judged rashly; they’ll be paid according to their works. Therefore, those who strike will in turn be struck by the Lord. VerseEnd Verse20 Take note of what the scripture says: People must not inflict harm or judge. The Lord has said: Judgment is Mine, and vengeance is Mine as well; I will repay. VerseEnd Verse21 Those who, in great anger, fight against the Lord’s work and against the Lord’s covenant people, who are the house of Israel, and say: We will destroy the Lord’s work, and the Lord won’t remember the covenant He’s made to the house of Israel — they’re in danger of being cut down and thrown into the fire. VerseEnd Verse22 Because the Lord’s eternal purposes will roll on until all His promises are fulfilled. VerseEnd

Verse23 Though I can’t write them, study Isaiah’s prophecies. Indeed, I tell 2PP you that those holy ones who have come before me and inhabited this land will cry out to the Lord, even from the dust. As the Lord lives, He will remember the covenant He made with them. VerseEnd Verse24 He knows their prayers on behalf of their fellow brothers and sisters. He knows their faith, because in His name they could remove mountains, and in His name they could make the earth shake; and by the power of His word they made prisons fall to the ground. Not even hot furnaces, wild animals, or venomous snakes could harm them, because of the power of His word. VerseEnd Verse25 Their prayers were also on behalf of him whom the Lord will allow to bring this record to light. VerseEnd Verse26 No one should say that it won’t come forth because it surely will, since the Lord has spoken it. It will come out of the earth by the Lord’s power, and no one can prevent it. It will appear at a time when people will say miracles are over. It will come just as if one had spoken from the dead. VerseEnd Verse27 It will come at a time when the blood of holy ones will cry out to the Lord because of secret conspiracies and works of darkness; VerseEnd Verse28 indeed, at a time when God’s power will be denied and churches will have become polluted and consumed with pride to their very center, when church leaders and teachers will be filled with pride to their very center, to the point of being envied by those who belong to their churches. VerseEnd Verse29 It will come at a time when people will hear of fires, storms, and vapors of smoke in foreign lands. VerseEnd Verse30 And people will hear of wars, reports of wars, and earthquakes in various places. VerseEnd Verse31 It will come at a time when there will be great pollutions on the earth: there will be murders, robbing, lying, deceiving, whoredoms, and all kinds of abominations; when there will be many who will say: Do this or do that, it doesn’t matter; the Lord will defend 2PP you on the last day. But woe to such people: they’re bitterly corrupted by sin. VerseEnd Verse32 It will come at a time when there will be churches built up that will say: Come to me, and for 2PP your money 2PP you’ll be forgiven of 2PP your sins. VerseEnd

Verse33 O 2PP you wicked, perverse, and stubborn people, why have 2PP you built up churches to yourselves to get money? Why have 2PP you altered God’s holy word so as to bring condemnation on 2PP your souls? Look to God’s revelations, because the time is coming when all these things will certainly be fulfilled. VerseEnd Verse34 The Lord has shown me great and awe-inspiring things about what’s going to take place soon after these words appear among 2PP you. VerseEnd Verse35 Now, I speak to 2PP you as though 2PP you were present, yet 2PP you are not. But Jesus Christ has shown 2PP you to me, and I know the things 2PP you do. VerseEnd Verse36 I know 2PP you live pridefully. There are none, except for a few, who aren’t lifted up in pride to their very center, to the point of wearing very fine clothing, and to the point of envying and strife, malice, persecution, and all kinds of iniquity. 2PP Your congregations and churches — every single one of them — have become polluted because of the pride of 2PP your hearts. VerseEnd Verse37 2PP You love money and 2PP your material possessions and 2PP your fine clothing and decorating 2PP your houses of worship more than 2PP you love the poor and the needy, the sick and the afflicted. VerseEnd Verse38 2PP You pollutions, hypocrites, and 2PP you teachers who sell yourselves for things that will corrode and decay, why have 2PP you polluted God’s holy congregation? Why are 2PP you ashamed to take upon yourselves the name of Christ? Why don’t 2PP you consider that the value of an endless happiness is greater than misery that never dies? Isn’t it because of the world’s praise? VerseEnd Verse39 Why do 2PP you adorn yourselves with things that have no life, and yet allow the hungry, the needy, the naked, the sick, and the afflicted to pass 2PP you by and not notice them? VerseEnd Verse40 Why do 2PP you build up 2PP your secret abominations for the purpose of getting rich and cause widows and orphans to mourn before the Lord, and make the blood of their fathers and husbands cry to the Lord from the ground for vengeance on 2PP your heads? VerseEnd Verse41 The sword of vengeance hangs over 2PP you; and the time is soon coming when He’ll avenge the blood of the holy ones upon 2PP you, since He won’t endure their cries any longer. VerseEnd

LEChapter9 Verse1 Now I’ll also speak to those who don’t believe in Christ. VerseEnd Verse2 Will 2PP you believe when He returns again? When the Lord comes — indeed, on that great day when the earth is rolled together as a scroll and the material elements melt with intense heat — on that great day when 2PP you’re brought to stand before the Lamb of God, will 2PP you then claim there’s no God? VerseEnd Verse3 Will 2PP you then continue to deny Christ, even when 2PP you behold the Lamb of God? Do 2PP you think 2PP you’ll live with Him under a consciousness of 2PP your guilt? Do 2PP you think 2PP you could be happy living with that holy Being when 2PP your souls are tormented with a consciousness of 2PP your guilt, that 2PP you’ve continually abused His laws? VerseEnd Verse4 I tell 2PP you that 2PP you would be more miserable living with a holy and righteous God under a consciousness of 2PP your filthiness before Him than 2PP you would be living with the damned souls in hell. VerseEnd Verse5 Indeed, when 2PP you’re brought to see 2PP your nakedness before God, as well as the glory of God and the holiness of Jesus Christ, it will light a flame of unquenchable fire in 2PP you. VerseEnd Verse6 O then, 2PP you who don’t believe, turn to the Lord! Cry powerfully to the Father in Jesus’ name, so perhaps 2PP you can be found spotless, pure, beautiful, and white on that great and last day, having been cleansed by the Lamb’s blood. VerseEnd

Verse7 Again I speak to 2PP you that deny God’s revelations and say they’ve ended, that there are no more revelations, prophecies, gifts, healing, speaking in tongues, or the interpretation of tongues. VerseEnd Verse8 I say to 2PP you: Those who deny these things don’t know Christ’s gospel. Indeed, they haven’t read the scriptures; if they have, they don’t understand them. VerseEnd Verse9 Don’t we read that God is the same yesterday, today, and forever, and there’s no variability or hint of changing in Him? VerseEnd Verse10 Now if 2PP you’ve pictured to yourselves a god who changes and there’s even a trace of changing in him, then 2PP you’ve imagined a god who isn’t a God of miracles. VerseEnd Verse11 But I’ll show 2PP you a God of miracles — indeed, the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob. That same God who created the heavens, the earth, and everything that’s in them. VerseEnd Verse12 He created Adam, and by Adam came the Fall of mankind. And because of the Fall of mankind came Jesus Christ, namely, the Father and the Son. Because of Jesus Christ we receive mankind’s redemption. VerseEnd Verse13 Because of mankind’s redemption, which came by Jesus Christ, they’re brought back into the Lord’s presence. This is how all people are redeemed, because Christ’s death brings about the resurrection, which brings about a redemption from an endless sleep, a sleep from which all people will be awakened by God’s power when the trumpet sounds. They will appear, both small and great, and all will stand at His place of judgment, being redeemed and freed from the eternal chains of death, a temporal death. VerseEnd Verse14 Then the judgment of the Holy One will be imposed upon them. The time will come when those that are filthy will remain filthy, and those that are righteous will remain righteous, and those that are happy will remain happy, and those that are unhappy will remain unhappy. VerseEnd

Verse15 Now, all of 2PP you that have pictured to yourselves a god who can’t perform any miracles, I want to ask 2PP you: Have all these things I’ve spoken about ended? Has the end come yet? I tell 2PP you: No. God hasn’t stopped being a God of miracles. VerseEnd Verse16 Doesn’t everything created by God inspire awe? Who can comprehend God’s miraculous works? VerseEnd Verse17 Who will say it wasn’t a miracle that by His word heaven and earth came into existence, and by the power of His word mankind was created from the dust of the earth, and by the power of His word miracles have been performed? VerseEnd Verse18 Who will say Jesus Christ didn’t do many powerful miracles? And His disciples did many powerful miracles also. VerseEnd Verse19 If miracles were done, then how has God stopped being a God of miracles, and yet is an unchangeable Being? I tell 2PP you: He doesn’t change; if so, He would stop being God. And He hasn’t stopped being God and is a God of miracles. VerseEnd Verse20 The reason He stops doing miracles among mankind is because they fall away in unbelief and turn from the right way, and don’t know the God they should trust. VerseEnd

Verse21 I say to 2PP you whoever believes in Christ, without doubting, anything they ask the Father in the name of Christ will be given to them. This promise is for everyone, even the whole earth. VerseEnd Verse22 Now Jesus Christ, the Son of God, instructed His disciples who were to remain, and also to all His disciples, which was overheard by the crowd: 2PP You are to go across the world and preach the gospel to everyone. VerseEnd Verse23 Anyone who believes and is baptized will be saved, but anyone who doesn’t believe will be damned. VerseEnd Verse24 And these signs will follow those who believe: In My name they’ll cast out devils, they’ll speak with new tongues, they’ll handle snakes, and if they drink anything deadly, it won’t hurt them; they’ll lay hands on the sick, and they’ll recover. VerseEnd Verse25 And those who believe in My name, who don’t doubt, to them I’ll confirm all My words, to the farthest reaches of the earth. VerseEnd Verse26 Now who can stand against the Lord’s works? Who can deny His words? Who will rise up against the Lord’s almighty power? Who will treat the Lord’s works with contempt? Who will treat Christ’s children with contempt? Take note, all 2PP you that treat the Lord’s works with contempt: 2PP you will die and be astonished. VerseEnd

Verse27 Therefore don’t disregard these things, treat them with contempt, or be astonished by them, but pay attention to the Lord’s words and ask the Father in Jesus’ name for whatever 2PP you might need. Don’t doubt, but be believing. Begin as in former times and come to the Lord with 2PP your whole heart and work out 2PP your own salvation before Him with awe and reverence. VerseEnd Verse28 Be wise in the days of 2PP your probation. Rid yourselves of all uncleanliness. Don’t ask in order to satisfy 2PP your lusts, but ask with unshaken firmness not to yield to any temptation, and to serve the true and living God. VerseEnd Verse29 Make sure 2PP you aren’t baptized unworthily. Make sure 2PP you don’t take the sacrament of Christ unworthily. But make sure 2PP you do all things in worthiness and do them in the name of Jesus Christ, the Son of the living God. If 2PP you do this and persevere to the end, 2PP you won’t under any circumstances be thrown out. VerseEnd Verse30 I speak to 2PP you as though I spoke from the dead because I know 2PP you’ll have my words. VerseEnd

Verse31 Don’t condemn me because of my imperfection, or my father because of his imperfection, or those who have written before him, but rather give thanks to God that He has shown 2PP you our imperfections, so 2PP you can learn to be wiser than we’ve been. VerseEnd Verse32 We’ve written this record, according to our knowledge, in characters we call reformed Egyptian, handed down and adapted by us to fit our speech. VerseEnd Verse33 If our plates had been large enough, we would have written in Hebrew; but the Hebrew characters have been adapted by us as well. If we could have written in Hebrew, however, there wouldn’t have been any miscommunications in our record. VerseEnd Verse34 But the Lord knows what we’ve written and that no other people understand our language. Because no other people understand our language, He has prepared instruments for its translation. VerseEnd Verse35 These things are written so we can rid our clothes of the blood of our fellow brothers and sisters, who have fallen away in unbelief. VerseEnd Verse36 What we want for them is their restoration to the knowledge of Christ, consistent with the prayers of all the holy ones who have lived in the land. VerseEnd Verse37 May the Lord Jesus Christ let their prayers be answered according to their faith. And may God the Father remember the covenant He’s made with the house of Israel, and may He bless them forever through faith in the name of Jesus Christ. Amen. VerseEnd
